rationale: C3XRP coarse proxy found 5 units meet Type-I/power targets, but (a) real imagery reliability is typically LOWER than the synthetic r_img, so a margin above the coarse minimum is prudent; (b) Delta CI width narrows from 5->7 (gain -0.014) more than 7->9 (gain 0.014), i.e. the precision return per added unit diminishes after 7; (c) 9 units add ~28% scan burden for marginal gain. 7 imagery + 7 complete-content perception units is the smallest robust design. NOT auto-minimum; NOT chosen from any neural outcome.
